environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance with Docker container running as root. Container has /var/log/app mounted as a Docker volume (rw). Logs are consumed by Fluentd sidecar that parses structured log lines and forwards to Elasticsearch. No input sanitization on log entries beyond DRF serializer max_length. AUDIT_LOG_PATH=/var/log/app/audit.log.

config.filesystem: /var/log/app is a named Docker volume mounted read-write
